purpose: Records every external dataset considered for Phase 7 benchmark construction. All entries verified against actual availability.

datasets.name: IPC2BNS-Verify Internal Concordance Table
datasets.why_used: PRIMARY AUTHORITATIVE GROUND TRUTH. Every benchmark question referencing a section mapping must trace to this table.

datasets.name: CrPC->BNSS Hard-Coded Map
datasets.why_used: AUTHORITATIVE ground truth for all Category B (CrPC->BNSS) questions.

datasets.name: India Code Official Statutory Text
datasets.license: Public domain (Government of India open data)
datasets.why_used: Primary authoritative source for section text verification. Section existence/text verified through existing cleaned corpus and concordance table which cites india_code as source.

datasets.name: ILSI / LeSICiN (Legal Statutory Information for Court in India)
datasets.paper: Kapoor et al. (2022) - LeSICiN: A Heterogeneous Graph-Based Approach for Automatic Legal Statute Identification
datasets.original_task: Automatic legal statute identification from facts
datasets.records_retained: TBD - filtered for IPC sections in concordance_v1.csv
datasets.why_used: Provides realistic natural-language fact descriptions mapped to IPC sections. Useful for Category C (natural scenarios) and Category A (direct IPC->BNS).
datasets.availability_note: GitHub repo exists. Requires manual download or requests. License is for research use.

datasets.name: ILDC (Indian Legal Documents Corpus)
datasets.paper: Malik et al. (2021) - ILDC for CJPE: Indian Legal Documents Corpus for Court Judgment Prediction and Explanation
datasets.license: Research use only (not for commercial use)
datasets.records_relevant: Criminal cases with IPC/BNS citations - estimated 5,000-10,000
datasets.records_retained: TBD - used only to extract realistic fact patterns for IPC->BNS transformation
datasets.why_used: SECONDARY - large corpus of criminal cases with IPC citations. Used to derive realistic fact patterns, NOT as direct QA benchmark.
datasets.availability_note: Dataset must be requested from authors. Cannot be downloaded directly without agreement.
datasets.important_note: ILDC questions are NOT claimed as IPC->BNS benchmark. They are used to derive scenarios with clear transformation steps documented.

datasets.name: IndicLegalQA
datasets.original_task: Indian legal QA in multiple languages
datasets.why_used: Natural-language Indian legal questions. Useful for Category C and I after filtering.
datasets.availability_note: Available via HuggingFace datasets library. Requires datasets package.

note: All dataset availability statuses marked CHECK_REQUIRED are verified programmatically in phase7/scripts/collect_sources.py
